description: This file defines error handling utilities, including a custom error class with error codes, functions to convert unknown errors, and functions to handle HTTP response errors.

classes.name: ErrorWithCode
classes.description: A custom Error class that includes an ErrorCode and optional data, with a static Factory proxy for creating errors based on error codes.

methods.name: getErrorFromUnknown
methods.description: Converts an unknown error to an Error object, with special handling for string causes and non-error types.

methods.name: handleErrorsJson
methods.description: Processes a fetch Response object, handling gzip encoding, empty responses, and error responses, returning parsed JSON data.

methods.name: handleErrorsRaw
methods.description: Processes a fetch Response object, handling empty responses and errors, returning response text.
